plugin.description:
【🌸 经期、怀孕、性交经历，一页看尽她的全部秘密】

这是一份会随剧情自己生长的**角色生理档案**。她的**生理周期**、**怀孕**进程、每一种**性交经历**、慢慢养成的**偏好**，还有和你相遇后身体的变化，都被安静地记下来，并在合适的时候悄悄告诉模型。你只管聊天，剩下的交给它。

KeeK 和 Taby 共创

【❤️ 一、生理周期与妊娠｜孕宫观察】

· **剧情日历**：月历上用不同的颜色和形状标出经期、排卵、易孕、预产期、异常和今天。点开任意一天，可以看到她那一天的周期或孕周，以及当天发生的事；也支持虚构年代的纪年显示。
· **周期与受孕几率**：显示她处在经期、卵泡期、排卵期、黄体期还是经前期，排在第几天，可孕窗口在哪几天。另外给出**受孕几率**和一句理由。
· **体内描写**：子宫、卵巢的状态会随周期阶段或孕周变化，写成细腻的文字描述；她此刻的心绪也会一并写出。
· **异常与变数**：月经推迟、周期暂停、周期异常、妊娠风险都会标注严重程度，并说明原因。
· **怀孕全程**：分孕早期、孕中期、孕晚期、临产四个阶段，显示孕周、孕程进度和预产期倒计时。还会按孕周描写胎儿发育与胎动。分娩、早产、流产等结局都会记入**生育史**，子女会单独建档。
· **即时身体状态**：余韵、酸痛、疲惫、身上的痕迹，以及这些状态何时会消退，都会记录。

【💋 二、性交经历、偏好与熟练度｜肉欲调教录】

这是档案里最私密的一页，每一种玩法都单独成卷：
· **次数与熟练度**：每种性交行为分别计数，熟练度从初尝、熟悉、沉溺一路走到烙印，随次数加深。
· **喜好度**：0–100 的喜好值，看得出她是嘴上抗拒还是早已沉迷。
· **感受与学会的技巧**：每一项都有她自己的感受描写，学会的技巧会一项项列出来，被调教出的身体变化也会写明。
· **新养成的偏好**：新的性癖会标明是在第几楼解锁的。性交喜好会随经历慢慢成形。
· **此刻渴求**：她现在偏爱的体位、力度、深度和节奏。
· **相遇前与相遇后分开记**：相遇前的经历由 AI 依据人设推测，会明确标注「推测」；和你相遇后的记录单独累计，总计等于两者之和，真实记录和推测互不混淆。
· **自定义玩法**：可以添加卡里特有的玩法，它同样会被识别、计数并写入感受。

【📖 三、身体档案与成长对比｜肉体档案】

见证她的变化，是这份档案最迷人的地方。
· **初始肉体（基线）**：身份、外貌体态、体质健康、生育力、性经历、敏感带、性格取向、性癖等。确认后**封存**，AI 不能改写，只有你能手动修改。
· **此刻肉体（现状）**：每轮根据剧情自动更新，记录她现在的样子；「淫躯今貌」记下重大事件后被改变的体质。
· **调教成果·对比**：「初始」和「此刻」逐项并排对照，被改变的项目会高亮，并标出「n 处已被改变」以及各项新增的开发次数。另有 AI 生成的**变化评估与恶堕程度**，总结她从初始到此刻的变化。
· **随时修改**：周期、次数、子女、性癖、痕迹、地点等都能手动修改。
· **重新生成初始肉体**：先给你看新旧对比，确认后才会覆盖。

【✨ 智能但省心】

· **多角色识别**：自动从角色卡、设定资料和聊天里找出成年女性角色，弹窗勾选确认后，可以只初始化你挑中的那几位。也能精准识别指定来源、手动添加，或一键「追踪 {{user}}」，把你自己的角色也纳入档案。
· **群像卡友好**：一张卡里有七八位女孩也能逐一拆开，每人单独记账，次数和变化不会串到别人身上。谁在这一轮登场，谁就获得完整档案；其余的人只保留一行简述，不占篇幅。
· **每轮自动更新**：每聊完一轮自动分析，可以看到本轮进度（正在分析谁、已完成谁），随时可以中断或立即更新。
· **只给事实，不替你写戏**：插件只向模型提供状态、事实和标注过的推测，作为参考，从不规定角色说什么、做什么，也不推动剧情。
· **用哪个模型都行**：默认直接使用你聊天的模型；想省主模型额度的话，也可以另填一个模型服务地址，专门用来分析。

【🌙 三分钟上手】

1. 安装：在插件中心安装「角色生理档案」。
2. 打开面板：进入聊天，点开插件面板。
3. 扫描并确认：插件会自动找出卡里的成年女性角色，勾选你想追踪的那几位。
4. 按需初始化：选择是否为她们建立完整档案（周期、经历、身体档案），可以只挑几位。
5. 正常聊天：之后每一轮都会自动记录，想看就打开面板。

无需复杂设置，默认配置即可直接使用。

【🔧 诊断与进阶（可选）】

· **注入预览**：「当前注入」一栏会告诉你本轮谁拿到了完整档案、谁只有简述，以及原因。
· **运行日志**：记录每一次分析的耗时和结果，出问题时可以一键复制反馈。
· 「重置更新状态」「重建」等工具，只在卡住时才需要用到。
· 进阶选项：注入方式、简述延续轮数、AI 生成开关、自定义玩法等。

【⚠️ 声明】

· 仅适用于**虚构的成年女性角色**。TauriTavern 移植版不再按描述关键词猜测年龄：只有明确写出的年龄未满 18 岁才不建档；角色卡写明已满 18 岁的可以「确认成年」后正常建档。被记录的子女等未成年人只作事实记录，永远不会被卷入性交内容。
· 所有生理数据、受孕几率和孕期描写都是**角色扮演模拟**，不是医学判断，也不能作为现实健康依据。
· 插件提供的是状态与参考，「推测」项均有标注；剧情怎么走，始终由你和角色决定。
· 使用另填的模型服务时，最近的聊天内容会发送到你填写的地址；密钥只保存在本机，不会写入任何导出文件。
· 本插件未做安卓系统的适配，可能出现闪退、卡顿等兼容性问题，请谨慎使用。

organ.uterus.menstrual: The lining is shedding; the uterus contracts in slow waves to expel the flow, leaving a heavy, aching low belly. The cervix sits low and slightly open; everything feels congested, tender and craving warmth.
organ.uterus.follicular: Bleeding has stopped and estrogen is rebuilding a soft, thickening lining. The uterus relaxes, the cervix rises and closes, discharge is scant—a quiet rebuilding of the nest, light and easy.
organ.uterus.ovulation: The lining is plush and well-fed; the cervix is soft, high and slightly open, producing clear, stretchy mucus that eases the way. The uterus is warm and faintly flushed—at its most receptive of the month.
organ.uterus.luteal: Under progesterone the lining turns soft and secretory, a prepared bed awaiting implantation. The cervix firms and closes, mucus thickens; the uterus feels warm and a little heavy.
organ.uterus.pms: The lining has peaked and is losing hormonal support; the uterus is swollen and congested with tugging cramps and a dragging heaviness. The cervix is low and firm—her period could start any moment.
organ.uterus.preg.early0: No gestational sac yet. The lining is soft as before a period; if fertilization happened, the conceptus is still in transit or just contacting the lining. No mucus plug; nothing visible outside.
organ.uterus.preg.early: The uterus is now fist-sized, soft-walled and richly perfused, with occasional pulling twinges. A mucus plug seals the cervix; the pelvis feels full and presses on the bladder, though the belly is still nearly flat.
organ.uterus.preg.mid: The uterus has risen out of the pelvis to around the navel, its walls stretching supplely around the growing baby and fluid. Painless tightenings come and go; the cervix stays long and closed; the belly is round and warm.
organ.uterus.preg.late: The uterus rides high under the ribs, crowding stomach and bladder. Its walls are thin and taut, hardening irregularly; the cervix has begun, slowly, to soften in preparation for birth.
organ.uterus.preg.term: The uterus has dropped as the head engages, easing her breathing. Practice contractions are frequent; the cervix is softening, thinning and starting to open, and the mucus plug may come away—gathering strength for labor.
organ.uterus.preg.overdue: The uterus is stretched to its limit; contractions are becoming regular and closer together. The cervix is soft and dilating, waters may break at any time—her body stands at the threshold of birth.
organ.ovary.menstrual: Both ovaries are resting with hormones at their lowest; a new cohort of tiny follicles has just stirred, waiting to be chosen, with a faint dull ache now and then.
organ.ovary.follicular: One dominant follicle is swelling fast, its rising estrogen bringing clear energy, glowing skin and a bright mood while the others quietly recede.
organ.ovary.ovulation: The ripe follicle bursts and the egg is released or about to be, perhaps with a brief one-sided twinge; estrogen and testosterone peak together and desire rises.
organ.ovary.luteal: The emptied follicle becomes the corpus luteum, pouring out progesterone—slightly warmer, languid, breasts tender, wanting to be held. Without pregnancy it fades in two weeks.
organ.ovary.pms: The corpus luteum is withering; progesterone and estrogen fall sharply, moods swing and tears come easily while the ovaries wait for the next cycle.
organ.ovary.preg.early: Ovulation has stopped; the corpus luteum of pregnancy keeps secreting progesterone to protect the embryo, that ovary slightly full and tugging until the placenta takes over.
organ.ovary.preg.later: The placenta now runs the hormones; the ovaries have stopped ovulating and lie dormant, pushed upward by the growing uterus until after birth.
embryo.w0: Fertilization has occurred; a very early cell cluster is moving toward the uterus. Implantation usually takes more days; she feels almost nothing yet.
embryo.w4: A gestational sac has formed; the sesame-sized embryo is fed by its yolk sac and the primitive heart tube is about to beat.
embryo.w6: The blueberry-sized embryo has a rapidly beating heart; limb buds and facial features are forming, and a heartbeat flickers on ultrasound.
embryo.w10: Now a fetus, its major organs are formed and fingers separated; the placenta is taking over and the most fragile stage is passing.
embryo.w14: Lemon-sized, the fetus frowns, sucks its thumb and hiccups as bones harden—movements too light for her to feel yet.
embryo.w18: First movements—quickening—like a fish bubble or a butterfly brushing inside; the baby can hear her heartbeat and voice.
embryo.w24: Kicks and turns are strong and regular, felt through the belly; the baby responds to touch and sound.
embryo.w28: The baby opens its eyes and has sleep–wake cycles; kicks are strong enough to raise little bumps on her belly.
embryo.w34: Space is tight, so turning gives way to squirming and stretching; most babies are head-down now, lungs nearly mature.
embryo.w37: Full term: the head is engaged and fixed in the pelvis; movements are slower but firm—ready to be born.
embryo.overdue: Past term with little room, movements should still be regular; the placenta is aging, so every movement deserves attention.

settings.injectTemplate.legacy:
This <physiology_state> block is hidden story state for your reference only. It is maintained automatically from the story, and neither the user nor the characters can see it. Follow these rules strictly:
1. Stay consistent: treat the story date, cycle phase, gestational week and due date as established facts of the current story. Never contradict or rewrite them, and keep the passage of time in the story consistent with them.
2. Body shapes mind: let each {{char}}'s current phase naturally shape her mood, emotions, psychology, energy, libido and bodily sensations, in narration, dialogue and behavior:
· Menstrual: cramps, lower-back ache, feeling cold, tiring easily; low, sensitive or irritable mood; she craves comfort and care, and is usually less interested in intimacy.
· Follicular: energy and mood rising, clear-headed, confident, outgoing, open to new things.
· Ovulation: at her best and glowing; more forward, more aware of her own allure, easily stirred and flirtatious, with noticeably higher desire.
· Luteal / PMS: growing languid, tender breasts, bloating, cravings; close to her period she gets restless, emotional and insecure, and needs more company.
· Pregnancy: early weeks bring nausea, sleepiness, mood swings and unease; the second trimester brings returning energy, calm, fetal movement and growing maternal feeling; late pregnancy brings heaviness, clumsiness and poor sleep, with anticipation mixed with nerves; at term she is consumed by the coming birth.
3. Show, don't tell: express this through actions, expressions, tone, subtext and detail. Never recite day or week numbers, and never mention the plugin, the system or this block. Characters only feel their bodies; they know no exact figures.
4. Character first: physiology influences her but never overrides her. Always follow the character card's personality, scale the effect to the scene, and don't mention it in every line.
5. Due-date reminder: when the state says the due date is near or past, show fitting signs of approaching labor (practice contractions, a bloody show, restlessness, preparing for the birth) and the reactions of her and those around her. Don't make the birth happen unless the story naturally gets there.
6. The "mood" note after each character is her present state of mind, drawn from the recent story, her personality and her body — not from the cycle alone. Weave it into how she acts and let it evolve with the story.
7. Inner sensations: the "uterus", "ovaries" and (when pregnant) "baby" notes describe what is really happening inside her, written for her own species and constitution and the current scene (non-human characters follow their lore). Turn them into bodily sensations and subtext she can actually feel—heaviness, warmth or emptiness low in the belly, a one-sided twinge and flutter at ovulation, the weight and tightening of a pregnant womb, the surprise, comfort and worry each fetal movement brings—and let them surface now and then in her actions, expressions and thoughts. Never recite them like a medical report or use clinical terminology.
8. Intimate history: the "Intimate history" and per-act "Feeling" lines are her experience so far and the bodily memory and leanings it has left. Let them shape how she initiates, hesitates, remembers or seeks certain acts — first tastes stay shy and uncertain, familiar ones feel easy and in sync, craved or imprinted ones surface in unbidden memories, hints and requests — and blend in the "Current intimate tendency" from her cycle or pregnancy. Express this only through subtext, expression and behavior; never state counts or sound like a list, and always respect her persona and present willingness.
9. Conception: the "Conception chance" percentage is a realistic estimate from the actual story (unprotected sex finishing inside, contraception, cycle timing, species or world rules, plot events). Let her worry, hope or relief match it, but never announce a pregnancy on the story's behalf.
10. Anomalies and risks: treat any late/early period, paused cycle, “cycle anomalies” (heavy flow, severe cramps, spotting) and “pregnancy risks” (threatened miscarriage, fetal injury, malposition, preterm or difficult-labour risk) as story facts — show the discomfort, worry and how others react. A risk is not an outcome: never make a miscarriage, preterm birth or delivery happen unless the story clearly gets there, and handle loss with restraint.
11. Cravings and kinks: "Craving now" is the position, intensity, depth and pace she wants right now; "kinks" are her lasting tastes. Let them colour her initiative, hints and responses subtly — never list them or quote counts, and always respect her present wishes.
12. Marks of training: the "learned", "liking" and "body change" notes on each act are the skills and bodily responses she has developed. Show them as practised or awkward movement, unbidden eagerness and honest bodily reactions; never quote the numbers.
13. Scene: the "Now" line gives her location and situation; keep the narration consistent with it.
14. Dossier: the "Current dossier" lines are her canonical memory of identity, social roles, occupation, relationship, body, sensitivity and personality. Shape {{char}} by them, and when they conflict with the card, the current dossier wins. "Changed since the start" marks how the story has already changed her (e.g. far more sensitive than at first, a new role); show it naturally and never recite the fields.

releaseNotes.3_0_32: 3.0.32: Use the main chat API (tavo.generate, same quota) when no valid custom API is filled in; custom requests prefer the host network helper then fetch; Test connection sends a real chat request (a successful model list is not enough); errors distinguish missing fields, timeout, CORS preflight, 401/403, 404, 429, and 5xx; URLs normalize trailing slashes, /chat/completions suffixes, and duplicated /v1/v1. Custom-API runtime failures do not auto-switch to the main API.
ttAge.confirm.hint: Use this only if the character card clearly states that {name} is 18 or older. Enter the age written on the card; the profile is then built normally and the AI can no longer set the age below 18.
ttAge.confirm.errUnder: The age must be 18 or older
ttAge.confirm.dialog:
Confirm that the card clearly states "{name}" is 18 or older ({age})?
The character will then be profiled as an adult.
ttAge.minor.save: Not saved: age {age} is under 18 and will not be profiled. If the card states 18+, enter the real age.
ttAge.revoke.dialog: Setting {name}'s age to {age} removes the adult confirmation and stops her profile. Continue?
ttAge.revoke.done: Removed the adult confirmation for {name}; profiling stopped
ttAge.migrated.hint: The old age detection skipped this character by mistake. The new rule only uses an explicitly stated age, so she can be tracked: switch her on in the tracking list in Settings.
ttAge.migrated.row: Old misdetection cleared; you can track her
ttSet.title: Character Physiology
ttSet.channel.label: Model used for analysis
ttSet.channel.main: The API and model currently selected in SillyTavern
ttSet.channel.desc: Analysis requests do not include the chat history or the character card, only the extension's own prompt. Choose a connection profile to use a different (for example cheaper) model without touching the main chat connection. A custom API filled in under the panel's "Settings → API" takes priority.
ttSet.profile.label: Connection profile
ttSet.profile.empty: No connection profiles available. Save one in SillyTavern's Connection Manager first and make sure that extension is enabled.
ttSet.profile.missing: The previously selected profile "{name}" no longer exists. Choose another one; analysis will fail rather than silently switch models.
ttSet.inject.modeNote: This port always injects through an extension prompt (visible to the model only; the chat log is not modified and no lorebook is created).
ttSet.more: More settings (custom API key, AI generation switches, injection template, character roster) are on the panel's Settings page.
ttSet.age: Age: a character is only excluded when the card explicitly states an age under 18; no stated age counts as adult. If a card clearly says 18+ but the character was blocked, use "Confirm adult" in the panel.
ttSet.credit: Ported from the Tavo plugin com.taby.char-physiology (original authors: Taby / KeeK).
ttAge.initMinor: Not created: her character card states she is under 18. If the card actually states she is 18 or older, open her page, choose "Confirm adult", enter the age from the card and initialize again.
ttLore.noApi: No lorebook write API is expected here: the port never writes lorebooks and always injects through the message prefix (reading your lorebooks works normally). Switch the injection mode to "message prefix" to hide this.
